issues.title: Needless return statement in function
issues.description: The rule requires all Rust code to pass 'cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings' without any warnings. The code contains an unnecessary explicit return statement that Clippy will flag with the needless_return lint.
issues.rule_name: Rust Code Must Pass Clippy Linting with Warnings Denied

issues.title: GitHub mirror URL construction missing path component
issues.description: The generate_github_mirror_url_from_base function is supposed to construct a mirror URL by combining the base CDN URL with the GitHub asset path. However, the code removed the cdn.set_path(github_url) call, meaning the mirror URL will only return the base CDN URL without the asset path. This causes downloads from configured GitHub mirrors to fail because they'll request the wrong URL. When users configure TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR to use a mirror server, all downloads will fail with 404 errors since the asset path is missing from the constructed URL.

issues.title: WebView2 offline installer bypasses platform certificate verification
issues.description: The download_webview2_offline_installer function was modified to use ureq::get() directly instead of calling the download() helper function. This bypasses the new platform certificate verification feature introduced in this PR. While webview2_guid_path correctly uses base_ureq_agent() which includes platform cert verification, the actual file download in lines 65-68 uses the default ureq::get which doesn't respect platform certificates. This inconsistency means WebView2 downloads will fail on systems that require custom certificate authorities (corporate environments, China, etc.) defeating the purpose of this PR.

issues.title: Inverted condition prevents lock version display for multiple crate versions
issues.description: The condition on line 194 checks if lock exists AND packages are NOT empty, but this logic is backwards. The code should handle the case where multiple versions exist in the lock file (when crate_lock_packages.len() != 1 as per line 170). The correct behavior is to show lock versions when the lock exists but no single matching package was found earlier. By inverting the is_empty check, the code now only executes when packages DO exist, which is the opposite of the intended scenario. This breaks the display of version information when there are dependency conflicts or multiple versions of the same crate.

issues.title: crate_latest_version missing proxy configuration with platform-certs
issues.description: The crate_latest_version function's platform-certs implementation is missing .proxy(ureq::Proxy::try_from_env()) configuration on line 128. This is inconsistent with the base_ureq_agent() pattern used elsewhere in the PR. Users behind corporate proxies or in restricted network environments will be unable to check for crate updates when the platform-certs feature is enabled, as the HTTP requests will fail to respect proxy environment variables.

issues.title: GitHub mirror downloads bypass platform certificate verification
issues.description: When TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR or TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR_TEMPLATE environment variables are configured, the generate_github_alternative_url function returns ureq::agent() instead of base_ureq_agent(). This bypasses the new platform certificate verification feature introduced in this PR. Downloads from configured GitHub mirrors will fail on systems requiring custom certificate authorities (corporate environments, restricted regions like China), completely defeating the purpose of this PR for mirror configurations.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #13824 - feat(bundler/cli): Add feature flag to use system certificates

structured_output.summary:
This PR adds a `platform-certs` feature to `tauri-bundler` and `tauri-cli`, enabled by default. The feature turns on `ureq/platform-verifier`, so HTTPS requests trust the OS certificate store. The bundler gets a shared `base_ureq_agent()` helper that sets `RootCerts::PlatformVerifier` plus env proxy settings. The CLI's crates.io version check builds its own agent with the same TLS settings. The idea is good: people behind corporate TLS-intercepting proxies report this problem every week.

The diff also has changes that go beyond the stated goal, and some of them are regressions. `generate_github_mirror_url_from_base` no longer adds the GitHub path to the mirror URL, so every download through `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR` points at the mirror's root. The WebView2 offline installer download was moved from `download()` to a bare `ureq::get`, which skips the new platform-cert agent this PR is adding, along with mirror support and logging. Mirror downloads still use a plain `ureq::agent()` without platform certs. And the `crate_version` lock-version check was flipped with no explanation. That last one makes previously dead code run, which changes `tauri info` output.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The mirror-URL change breaks the `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR` feature: downloads go to the mirror root instead of the asset. The WebView2 change undoes the PR's own goal for that download. Both need fixing before merge.

architecture.overview:
Before this PR, every bundler download (AppImage tools, WiX/NSIS, WebView2) built a default `ureq::Agent` with proxy-from-env, and the request used ureq's bundled webpki roots. GitHub URLs could be rewritten to a mirror through `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR_TEMPLATE` or `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR`. The CLI called crates.io with the global `ureq::get` to look up the latest crate version.

The PR puts agent construction in `http_utils::base_ureq_agent()`. When the new default `platform-certs` feature is on, that helper sets `TlsConfig::root_certs(RootCerts::PlatformVerifier)`. `create_agent_and_url` and `webview2_guid_path` now call it. The CLI's `crate_latest_version` builds its own platform-verifier agent behind the same feature. Two paths don't use the new helper: the mirror path (`generate_github_alternative_url`), which still uses `ureq::agent()`, and the WebView2 offline installer download, which now calls `ureq::get` directly.
steps: Start at the Cargo features: `platform-certs` in `crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml` and `crates/tauri-cli/Cargo.toml` turns on `ureq/platform-verifier` and is part of `default`.
`http_utils::base_ureq_agent()` is the new shared builder. It sets the TLS root certs to PlatformVerifier when the feature is on, plus proxy from env.
`download()` → `create_agent_and_url()` picks either a mirror agent/URL from `generate_github_alternative_url` or `base_ureq_agent()` with the original URL.
`windows/util.rs`: `webview2_guid_path` uses `base_ureq_agent()` for the HEAD request. `download_webview2_offline_installer` now calls `ureq::get` directly.
CLI `cargo_manifest::crate_latest_version` builds a separate platform-verifier agent for crates.io. `crate_version` also has an unrelated condition flip.

findings.title: GitHub mirror base URL no longer includes the asset path
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-bundler/src/utils/http_utils.rs` lines 33-40, `generate_github_mirror_url_from_base` no longer calls `cdn.set_path(github_url)`, so it returns the bare mirror base URL and drops the asset path. Restore the `|mut cdn| { cdn.set_path(github_url); cdn.to_string() }` mapping. Then add a unit test in the existing `mod tests` that sets `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR` and checks that the returned URL contains the original GitHub path.

findings.title: WebView2 offline installer download skips the platform-cert agent
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-bundler/src/bundle/windows/util.rs` lines 62-69, `download_webview2_offline_installer` now uses `ureq::get(url)` directly. That skips `base_ureq_agent()`, so the platform certificate verifier this PR adds isn't used for this download. Replace the manual request and read with `std::fs::write(&file_path, download(url)?)?;` as it was before. Also remove the now-unused `io::Read` import at the top of the file.

findings.title: Unrelated inversion of the lock_version condition in crate_version
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-cli/src/helpers/cargo_manifest.rs` around line 194, the condition `lock.is_some() && crate_lock_packages.is_empty()` was flipped to `!crate_lock_packages.is_empty()`. This change has nothing to do with the platform-certs feature, and it changes `tauri info` output when multiple lock versions exist. Either revert it and open a separate PR, or keep it, add a `.changes` entry describing the new output, and add a unit test for `crate_version` with a lock containing two versions of the same crate.

findings.title: Mirror downloads still use a plain agent without platform certs
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-bundler/src/utils/http_utils.rs` line 49, `generate_github_alternative_url` builds mirror requests with `ureq::agent()`, which doesn't use the platform certificate verifier or the env proxy. Change it to use `base_ureq_agent()` so mirror downloads get the same TLS and proxy behavior as direct downloads.

findings.title: Agent construction is duplicated across both cfg branches and between crates
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-bundler/src/utils/http_utils.rs` lines 56-73, refactor `base_ureq_agent` so the builder chain is written once: build with the proxy first, then add `tls_config(... RootCerts::PlatformVerifier ...)` only under `#[cfg(feature = "platform-certs")]`, and drop the explicit `return`. Optionally do the same in `crates/tauri-cli/src/helpers/cargo_manifest.rs` lines 120-133, so `crate_latest_version` builds its agent through one cfg-gated helper instead of two duplicated blocks.

findings.title: Feature-gated, default-on design is a sensible answer to the PR's open question
findings.body: Making `platform-certs` a Cargo feature that's on by default fixes the common corporate-proxy case out of the box. Downstream packagers who want ureq's bundled roots only can still opt out with `--no-default-features --features rustls`. Wiring the CLI feature through to `tauri-bundler/platform-certs` keeps both crates consistent. One thing to note for reviewers: in the CLI, `platform-certs` and `native-tls` are independent features, and `rustls-platform-verifier` always needs rustls. Check that `--features native-tls` together with the default features still builds the way you expect.
